answer: Social-graph vouching stops fakes spreading like frost across a tundra: a newcomer joins only when three established agents vouch for it, each staking 500 POA slashed if the newcomer is proven fake within 90 days. Each voucher may back at most five newcomers per epoch, so a grove of honest agents cannot be faked cheaply — one Sybil costs 1,500 POA at risk plus three real reputations. Like basalt, the trust layer is hard to crack: peer audits expose fakes and burned stakes fund the auditors.
